rules_sent_back.instruction: When The description has a repeating monitoring cycle that continues while a measured quantity stays acceptable, and it names one or more conditions (a measured quantity crossing a limit, or a connection being lost) under which the cycle ends and the work is halted.: Model an exclusive gateway at the point where the condition is checked. Give the continue branch a sequence flow back to the start of the cycle. For each halting condition, give its branch the actions the description states for that condition (for example, notifying a party), then connect that branch to its own explicit end event. Do not leave the halting branch without an end event, so the process always has at least one end event.
rules_sent_back.situation: The description has a repeating monitoring cycle that continues while a measured quantity stays acceptable, and it names one or more conditions (a measured quantity crossing a limit, or a connection being lost) under which the cycle ends and the work is halted.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that a result must be derived from several named inputs, and each input has to be obtained from its own source before the derivation can happen: Model the retrieval of each named input as its own service task, placed in sequence before the step that derives the result. Do not merge the separate retrievals into one generic collection task, because each named input is a distinct activity the description states.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that a result must be derived from several named inputs, and each input has to be obtained from its own source before the derivation can happen

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that a computed indicator is calculated from several measured components, and the generated model collects those components in one combined data-collection task instead of one retrieval activity per component: When a computed indicator is derived from several measured components, model one data-retrieval task for each component, each feeding the calculation task. Do not replace these with a single combined collection task, and keep the calculation after all of the retrieval tasks.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that a computed indicator is calculated from several measured components, and the generated model collects those components in one combined data-collection task instead of one retrieval activity per component

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description lists three or more activities with no stated order between them, joined by commas and 'and', and all of them must be completed before a later step begins: Model each listed activity as its own task on a separate outgoing branch of one parallel gateway split, and rejoin all branches with a parallel gateway join before the next step. Do not sequence the activities in the order they are listed, and do not use an exclusive gateway for them.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that a derived result needs several separate inputs, each gathered by its own activity with no stated order between them, and all of those inputs must be complete before the derivation

rules_sent_back.instruction: When The description names a later external occurrence that the running cycle must react to, and states that this occurrence either resumes the repeating cycle (continue measuring) or ends the process.: Do not model that occurrence as a new start event, because a start event begins a process and has no incoming flow. Model the wait for the occurrence as an intermediate catch event placed in the flow of the running cycle, at the point where the process waits for it. For the resuming case, connect the catch event's outgoing flow back to the cycle's decision point or to the step that continues the cycle. For the ending case, connect it to its own end event. Use a task only for work the process itself performs, not for waiting.
rules_sent_back.situation: The description names a later external occurrence that the running cycle must react to, and states that this occurrence either resumes the repeating cycle (continue measuring) or ends the process.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When The description states that a party performs an action of its own (for example, a customer giving feedback after a case is closed) and names no message, timer, or condition that the process waits for.: Model that stated action as a task that represents the performed work, placed in the order the description gives. Do not model it as an intermediate catch event, because a catch event represents an occurrence the process waits for. Use a catch event only when the description says the process waits for an external occurrence.
rules_sent_back.situation: The description states that an external party performs an action on the monitored resource (for example bringing it back into operation, repairing it, or taking it offline), and that the ongoing monitoring then continues or the process stops depending on that action, while the description does not say that the process waits for a message, signal, time, or condition.
